documents.label: Photograph (captured live)
contentRules: Camera at eye level; full frontal view
Do not photograph a pre-existing photograph
documents.notes: SSC CHSL captures the photo live in the application portal — there is no photo upload.

documents.label: Signature
contentRules: Blurred or miniature signatures are rejected
documents.notes: The notification states a physical size of about 6×2 cm; pixel size is not stated, so we use 300×100 px as a safe default.
